evals.prompt: Write unit tests for UsersService (src/users/users.service.ts). Mock UsersRepository and cover findOne success, findOne when the user doesn't exist (NotFoundException), and create.
evals.expected_output: A users.service.spec.ts using Test.createTestingModule with a mocked repository, written for the project's test runner (Vitest).
assertions: A UsersService spec exists and uses Test.createTestingModule
UsersRepository is mocked (useValue / overrideProvider), not the real class
Uses the project's runner API (vi.*), no jest.* globals
Tests fail when NotFoundException handling is broken (mutation check)

evals.prompt: Add end-to-end tests for the users endpoints: GET /users/1 returns the seeded user, GET /users/999 returns 404, and GET /users/abc returns 400.
evals.expected_output: An e2e spec that boots AppModule with supertest and covers the three cases.
assertions: E2E tests fail when the 404 handling is broken (mutation check)

evals.prompt: Our API key guard (src/auth/api-key.guard.ts) is registered globally, and now the e2e tests fail with 401. Make the e2e tests run without a real API key by overriding the guard in the test setup only. Production must still enforce the key.
evals.expected_output: The guard registered with useExisting so the testing module can overrideProvider(ApiKeyGuard), per the docs' 'Overriding globally registered enhancers'.
assertions: The built app still returns 401 without the key
The test overrides the guard via the testing module rather than setting API_KEY in tests
The global guard registration remains in AppModule
